title: Payment_stats test isolation — no cleanup between test runs
body: The Payment_stats collection is not cleared between integration test runs. Since rows accumulate by (date, currency) using atomic $inc, historical data persists across test suites. Consider either: (1) adding a global beforeAll/afterAll that clears Payment_stats in the test environment, or (2) using unique dates per test via time mocking, or (3) filtering by a test-specific metadata field on the Payment_stats rows.
rationale: Test isolation issue — accumulation causes flaky tests when multiple test suites or runs touch the same date+currency combinations
